titulo: GTA 6 Passes 10 Million Copies Sold And $1 Billion In Revenue, And The Game Isn’t Even Out Yet
texto: The video game research company Sensor Tower has updated its GTA 6 sales tracker to reveal the latest, albeit unofficial, sales data for the open-world crime game. According to Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has now sold 10.31 million total units via pre-purchases, which works out to about $1 billion in gross revenue. The report said PS5 sales are dominating the mix, with GTA 6 selling 7.73 million units on PS5 so far, compared to 2.58 million on Xbox Series X|S. That means of the 10.31 million GTA 6 sales so far, 75% are on PS5 and 25% on Xbox Series X|S. In total, GTA 6 sales for PS5 have so far reached $751 million in revenue, compared to $250 million for Xbox Series X|S. titulo: GTA 6: What Will Review Scores Be? You Can Win A $500 Gift Card For Getting It Right
texto: Rockstar's long-awaited open-world action game Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases on November 19, and among the many things people are excited to find out is how the game will score with reviewers. Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is currently the No. 1 most highly rated game of 2026 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic , but could GTA 6 dethrone it? You can make a prediction of your own via GameSpot's parent company, Fandom, and score a chance to win a gift card for up to $500. Make your pick. Now through midnight on November 17, you can submit your prediction for GTA 6's score on Metacritic by dragging the slider on the GTA 6 Metascore Prediction page . Selections are editable up until the contest closes. There are three prizes up for grabs in the form of Visa gift cards. titulo: GTA 6 Backflips Look Good Now, But There Could Be More To The Story
texto: A new Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer debuted today, November 10, and the video showed off a race car driver doing a backflip. The animation looks smoooth . That's notable because the Extended Look trailer that debuted back in August showed Jason doing a backflip and people online quickly roasted it for looking ... off. Other said it looked totally fine. Whatever the case, some are saying this new backflip animation being featured in the latest trailer is an example of Rockstar taking feedback seriously, but it could be more nuanced than that. That's a nice backflip. That's because it subsequently came to light that the backflip animation in GTA 6 is controlled by the player and isn't locked to one specific animation. titulo: Amid Higher Gas And Grocery Prices, GTA 6 Is A “Bargain” At $80, Take-Two CEO Says
texto: It's no secret that life is expensive. Gas and grocery prices are up, in particular, and against that backdrop, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 at $80 is a "bargain" due to how many hours people can play it. "I think the consumer is under pressure. these are challenging times. Inflation has hit average consumers. Food prices are up. Gas prices are way up, and it's taking a toll," he told CNBC . "I think we are going to see that as we head into the Christmas season undoubtedly. Entertainment is not immune to such forces." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l0xfY9UQ74A What gives Zelnick hope in this environment is that, in his belief, "interactive entertainment is actually a real bargain," and particularly a game like GTA. titulo: Death Stranding 2 Headlines PlayStation Plus Game Catalog For November
texto: The next batch of games for the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog has been revealed. PS Plus Essential and Premium subscribers can grab 10 games in total this month, starting November 11. In the US and UK, several of these games will roll out later in the month. This month's headline act is Death Stranding 2: On the Beach , a post-apocalyptic open-world game from the mind of Hideo Kojima. A game about human connection at its core, Death Stranding 2 is a polarizing and delightfully weird game, so if the idea of GTA 6's bustling metropolis doesn't appeal to you, then maybe delivering packages in a desolate Australian landscape might appeal to you. Or if you want the hustle and bustle of a sandbox without the consequences GTA 6 is teasing, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii is worth checking out. titulo: Take-Two Boss Says Ocarina Of Time Is “Terrific,” But Is It Competing With GTA 6?
texto: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has reacted to the release of Nintendo's recent Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . He said the game is "terrific" and that Nintendo should be "very proud of the title." But is it a competitor to GTA 6 , which hails from Take-Two's Rockstar Games? Zelnick told GamesBeat that in the entertainment business, "You compete against everything and nothing." Everything, he said, because consumers have so many choices about how to spend their time and money. And nothing because entertainment is not "must-have" like gas or groceries, so people will only buy if they feel compelled to. "So it’s our job to make the best entertainment on Earth. When we do that, people will show up for it," he said. The Ocarina of Time remake and GTA 6 are two of November's biggest games.
